initial_requirements: The Expanded Very Large Array needs an operations system for configuring and monitoring its radio-astronomy correlator and processing the resulting data stream in real time. Scientists and engineers should be able to inspect system health and observational data, while the software assembles and transforms correlator output into usable results for downstream storage and analysis. The system should identify faults and recover automatically where practical.
pending_question: What are the primary operational goals and core capabilities this system must deliver for configuring the correlator, monitoring system health, and processing the data stream in real time?
